string.direction: Starts Perky, then turns very serious
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: Isn’t Reekwater wonderful! It’s so vibrant here, so alive! If the Soulwardens weren't dying, this is would be an amazing place.

string.context: Ever the optimist, she knew someone would come and help, even when everyone else gave up hope
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: I knew we’d get help, even when everyone else had given up hope. It's been hard on the others, especially with how many we've lost.

string.context: Normally upbeat, but the death of other Soulwardens is causing her distress.
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: It's terrible what's happening to the Soulwardens. We thought our Heartgems made us invincible!

string.context: Determined to make the most of a bad situation.
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: Now that you’ve met everyone, you should join our training exercises. We've been doing them to make sure our Heartgems stay strong, and our wills focused.

string.context: She knew someone would come and help, even when everyone else gave up hope
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: I knew we’d get help, even when everyone else had given up hope. It's been hard on the others, especially with how many we've lost.
"Wiltrud sent me to help."

string.context: She stayed behind in case help arrived, and it did!
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: That's wonderful! I had stayed down here in case my message got through to her. We’ve found a library that might help heal the heartgems.

string.context: Repsonding to the player saying "How far to the library?"
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: The library is up above. Darshan rushed on ahead, not wanting to waste any time. He was muttering about a key, and facing unknown dangers.

string.context: Things are all going to work out, now that the player has arrived
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: Perhaps you can catch up to him and help him with that key? He seems like he could use a hand. I'll let Wiltrud know you made it to us.
"Where can I find it?"

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: The goal of the Soulwardens is to make Reekwater a better place. It’s a lofty goal, I admit, and it keeps us busy.

string.context: The Soulwardens in Reekwater are having a rough time, and have lost many people.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Please tell me you’re here to help. We’re not desperate, not yet, but you might say we’re balanced on the edge of desperation.

string.context: Having to fight your friend now that they are undead, is the worst.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Losing Soulwardens in this place is a blow, but running into the Fallen Soulwardens again after they lost their Heartgems was more than some could take.

string.context: Continued from the previous line
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: We don’t know what damages Heartgems this way. Perhaps our process for making them was flawed.

string.context: Implying that with the player's help, things are getting better.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Reekwater may seem like a lost cause at times, but the Soulwardens are making a real impact here.

string.context: Wants to make sure the player sees the same thing she does - that she's not crazy.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Do you see what's wrong with the Damaged Heartgems?

string.context: Repsonding to the player saying "Yes, there are fractures."
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Exactly. Now you see what we’re up against. Something is weakening the resolve of the Soulwardens in Reekwater.

string.context: New eyes give fresh perspective.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: If only there was a way to strengthen our Heartgems. Hopefully you can help us discover one. We’ve already picked up a few Ancient tricks from the ruins.

string.context: Her fellow Soulwardens have created some amazing, and she wants to show it off.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: We managed to piece together enough Ancient machines to make our Soulwarden Armory. It’s truly a marvel. You should visit it to see what you can craft.
"Yes, there are fractures."

string.context: Darshan lost a lot of Soulwarden friends to dangers in Reekwater, and it's colored his view of the place.
string.speaker: Darshan Sharma
string.name: DarshanSharma

resources.string: You shouldn’t be here. I shouldn’t be here. This place – it’s not for people like us.

string.direction: same line as above, record once, and use for both
string.context: same line as above, record once, and use for both
string.speaker: Darshan Sharma
string.name: DarshanSharma

resources.string: You shouldn’t be here. I shouldn’t be here. This place – it’s not for people like us.

string.context: Repsonding to the player saying "It's not that bad."
string.speaker: Darshan Sharma
string.name: DarshanSharma

resources.string: How can you say that? We were both at Skyview. But you’ll see. Other places are far worse. You should leave while you can. Forget the swamps, go anywhere else.
"We'll get through this."

string.direction: Like a conspiracy theorist explaining their beliefs
string.context: Darshan has the answer, he's figured it out. No one else has.
string.speaker: Darshan Sharma
string.name: DarshanSharma

resources.string: The Ancient devices throughout Reekwater, do you know why they are activating?

string.context: He's in an area surrounded by undead skeletons on patrols, and isn't even in the library yet
string.speaker: Darshan Sharma
string.name: DarshanSharma

resources.string: Why did I have to be stationed here? This is a terrible place, filled with the worst horrors the Ancients unleashed.

string.context: Repsonding to the player saying "Asa said you found a key?"
string.speaker: Darshan Sharma
string.name: DarshanSharma

resources.string: Yes, I managed to find the key for the library door. I was on my way back to Asa when I got trapped.

string.context: Darshan is grateful the player arrived when they did, but doesn't like it here.
string.speaker: Darshan Sharma
string.name: DarshanSharma

resources.string: You can have the key, and my thanks. I'm glad you showed up, but I'm getting out of here while they are distracted!
"Asa said you found a key?"

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: I'm not going back out in the swamp. I've lost too many friends who went out, and never came back.

string.context: Things aren't going well for the Soulwardens in Reekwater.
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: There are things here I’ve never seen anywhere else on Aeternum! Sadly, that includes the loss of my friends, the Soulwardens whose Heartgems were damaged.

string.context: Repsonding to the player saying "How are you doing?"
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: Honestly, not good. I haven't left the settlement since the reports of the last Soulwarden who didn't make it back.

string.context: Far too honest
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: I try to put on a brave face, I want to help. But I just can't bring myself to face what's out there. What if I don't come back next time?
"How are you doing?"

string.direction: As if this is a juicy piece of gossip
string.context: Setting the player up to travel to a nearby location
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: By now you have come across the Heartgems of our fallen companions. I have heard rumors of a place where the Damaged Heartgems can be healed.

string.context: Hears a lot of rumors, but maybe believes only half of them.
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: Who knew that so many of the myths we’ve heard actually exist? Why, just yesterday I learned there really are terrible bear monsters in some caves!

string.context: He sent the player to the wrong location because he read the map wrong because it was shaking so much from how scaed he was.
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: Your courage inspired me to venture forth, but sadly the rumors were incorrect. There’s no altar here. Ah, I see where I went wrong, I had the map sideways.

string.context: Repsonding to the player saying "The map was sideways?"
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: Ha, yes. It must have been my nerves… The location of the altar is to the west of Farharbor, at Fisher's Glory. This time I'm sure I have it right.

string.context: Clearly, is not good at navigation or any wilderness skills
string.speaker: Kirksley Dunham
string.name: KirksleyDunham

resources.string: You'll check it out for me, won't you? I can't possibly do this on my own.
"The map was sideways?"

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: Did you know the Ancients used to have great machinery set up in Reekwater? Some say it is still active, if you can find it.

string.context: Almost Jealous the player was there, and she wasn't
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: I heard you were at Skyview, so you've seen Ancient machinery in action. Those doors! I'd love to learn how they work.

string.context: Responding to the player saying "Look at the map I found there."
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: Very nice! I can't wait to check out those sites! One of them is bound to help us figure out how to fix the Damaged Heartgems.
"Look at the map I found there."

string.direction: Like college professor far too interested in the subject they are teaching
string.context: Jane's really passionate about this topic
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: It is said that long ago, the Ancient used to make their Guardians in these festering swamps.

string.direction: Like college professor far too interested in the subject they are teaching
string.context: Jane's really passionate about this topic
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: They would fire up these great big machines, and to activate the Guardian they would insert some bloody great gem into the center of their chest.

string.context: The player provided Jane with information that allowed her to find this location, from their last quest for her
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: From the information you provided, I've learned of a Guardian Heartforge that is supposed to still be working after all this time!

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: I bet you love the swamp. Me, I’d give anything to be elsewhere.

string.context: The music is really getting to him, poor guy
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: Have you ever had a song stuck in your head, to the point where you can't think about anything else?

string.context: The Siren Queen's music is bad for Heartgems, but no one else seems to realize just how bad
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: I have sounded the alarm in Reekwater, but no one understands the danger.

string.direction: Way too happy to be in the swamp
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Lorenzo Blas
string.name: LorenzoBlas

resources.string: This place is wonderful for my work. So much to analyze, so much to test!

string.context: This is the most interesting thing in the world right now, forget all the dangers nearby!
string.speaker: Lorenzo Blas
string.name: LorenzoBlas

resources.string: Come here, look at this. See how Azoth seems to uniquely react to the water of Reekwater? It grows into shapes as if it’s living crystals!

string.context: Always just one step away from a brilliant solution, in between the previous quest for Azoth crystals and the next quest
string.speaker: Lorenzo Blas
string.name: LorenzoBlas

resources.string: I’m so close… I almost have it. I just need more time.

string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Uzoma Ndidi
string.name: UzomaNdidi

resources.string: Reekwater punishes the overconfident. The swamps will chew you up and spit you out, if you aren’t prepared.

string.context: Uzoma is a good judge of character and can tell the player has seen a thing or two in their time on Aeternum
string.speaker: Uzoma Ndidi
string.name: UzomaNdidi

resources.string: You look like a survivor. Someone who has been through a lot, and come out on top. That’s a useful skill, here in Reekwater.

string.context: Between the first quest the player did for Uzoma and the next quest, when the player goes up to get the next quest
string.speaker: Uzoma Ndidi
string.name: UzomaNdidi

resources.string: Ah, I'm glad you're here. It seems that those beasts have had time to move back into their caves.

string.direction: Little inflection or changes, almost monotone.
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Hyloros
string.name: Hyloros

resources.string: We sense an imbalance here. We must make sure the eternal cycle continues unimpeded.

string.direction: Little inflection or changes, almost monotone.
string.context: Informing the player why an Angry Earth is here, and talking to a human
string.speaker: Hyloros
string.name: Hyloros

resources.string: Nature is out of balance. We were sent to tend to this, to soothe that which is unharmonious.

string.direction: Little inflection or changes, almost monotone.
string.context: Angry Earth are hive minds and are referred to as plural
string.speaker: Hyloros
string.name: Hyloros

resources.string: The Protector of the Source still refuses to listen to us. Their mind has been closed off, filled with rage.

string.direction: Affronted, as if the player had insulted her
string.context: The players will hear this if they managed to make it into the zone before they can do any of the quests.
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: Just in case you were wondering - all the drinks I serve are clean.

string.direction: Affronted, as if the player had insulted her
string.context: Continued from the previous line
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: I run all the water I use through six layers of cloth, then triple distill it. Purest water you ever drank.

string.context: There's no good help to be found these days…
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: It’s hard enough finding good help without all the best workers getting lured away.
"Where are they going?"

string.context: Nelda is gicing the players new information about the banners seen throughout the zone
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: The Siren Queen’s causing trouble, mesmerizing the locals. Listening to her songs causes them to drop everything and run off.

string.context: It's a sad fact in Reekwater that the Siren Queen attracts followers
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: I’d hire more help, but everyone keeps joining that cursed Siren Queen.
"Help with what?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "Help with what?"
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: I'm sorry to say that we've lost a number of Soulwardens in this infernal swamp. Now, I don't expect you to bring them back.
"You don't?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "You don't?"
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Not yet, not until we can cure them. We don't know how, but some Soulwardens had their Heartgems fracture from the strain of this place. That's how they fell.
"You need those Heartgems."

string.context: Responding to the player saying “You need those Heartgems.”
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Exactly. Help us recover the Damaged Heartgems from Sunken Aspect. There has to be a way to fix them, to stop this madness. We owe that much to our fallen brethren.

string.context: A reminder in case the player forgets
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Please gather some Damaged Heartgems, we must preserve them.
Complete the Quest

string.context: Teaching the player the new zone currency through lore
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Now that you've seen the Armory, the truth is that we can use it to reforge Soulmarks collected from the Fallen Soulwardens once their Heartgems are damaged.
"Will our Heartgems hold?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "Will our Heartgems hold?"
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: It seems that Soulwardens with particularly robust Soulmarks are resilient enough to keep their Heartgems intact. For a time, at least.
"Can we repair the Heartgems?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "Can we repair the Heartgems?"
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: That remains to be seen. We have some leads. There’s an Ancient library at Skyview Repose, it might provide us with information about how to repair them.
"Perhaps I can help."

string.context: With the player's help, things are going to get better.
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: I was hoping you'd be willing to aid us. Look for Soulwarden Asa Takahashi near Skyview Repose, she has been leading that effort and should know more.

string.context: A reminder in case the player forgets
string.speaker: Wiltrud Bucheholz
string.name: WiltrudBucheholz

resources.string: Meet with the Soulwardens at Skyview Repose to learn more about how to repair the Damaged Heartgems.
Complete the Quest

string.context: Players have returned from a dangerous place and she's rightly impressed
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: It's amazing that you were able to get up into the library! Did you find anything we could use?
"A map showing Guardian Hearts."

string.context: Responding to the player saying "A map showing Guardian Hearts."
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: That's great! If we explore the locations listed on the map, we should find a way to fix the Damaged Heartgems in no time!
"Can we fix the Heartgems?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "Can we fix the heartgems?"
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: Not yet, but I know several of our best minds are working on it. Oh! You haven't met everyone here, have you?

string.context: This introduces the player to the next few major quest givers for side quests.
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: You should introduce yourself to the other Soulwardens. You might be able to help them with their investigations around Reekwater!

string.context: Imagines everyone will be friends!
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: Together we can figure out how to save the other Soulwardens, I can feel it!
Complete the Quest

string.context: Daydreams about work retreats where everyone has fun together, in reality, the Soulwardens are not all friends with each other
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: What do you think? They've seen a lot here, and it weighs on some. But together we are stronger, and we'll get through this if we all help each other out.
"Of course."

string.context: Believes that together we can get through the worst of things
string.speaker: Asa Takahashi
string.name: AsaTakahashi

resources.string: And we'll need help from everyone, not just Soulwardens, to pull through this crisis. So make sure you talk with everyone, they all have insights we can use.
"Are the songs back?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "Are the songs back?"
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: Yes. Thanks to you we know the songs come from the strange "banners" made by the Siren Queen. Those foul tangles of ancient relics and flotsam must be destroyed.

string.context: New information that ties the songs to the damage of Heartgems that is happening in Reekwater
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: The longer you listen to the songs, the more damage they inflict upon your Heartgem. We must destroy more banners to protect our Heartgems!

string.context: A reminder in case the player forgets
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: You know I can’t help. Once the songs take hold I forgot who I was for a week. When I came to… Well, you don’t want to know.
Complete the Quest

string.context: Honestly didn't think the player could resist the lure of the music
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: You’re back! I was beginning to think you might've joined the Siren Queen's crew!
"The banners are down."

string.context: Responding to the player saying "The banners are down."
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: That’s a relief. There was something mighty unnatural about them. I can feel my Heartgem healing already.

string.context: The quest isn't ready yet - come back later when it is
string.speaker: Rowland Chadwick
string.name: RowlandChadwick

resources.string: It won’t be long before the Siren Queen puts up more banners. She’s industrious like that.
"Her songs are back?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "Her songs are back?"
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: You'd better believe it. It's amazing how fast she can convince people to rebuild her machines.

string.context: Giving the player a quest to take out the Siren Queen's helpers
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: You'll need to take on those barnacles she calls her 'crew' and break up that Ancient machine again.

string.context: A reminder in case the player forgets
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: You'd best go and stop the Siren Queen, without her songs, maybe I can get my customers back!
Complete the Quest

string.direction: Honest praise dripping with sarcasm on "her highness"
string.context: The player has returned successfully and Nelda is honestly grateful
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: Nice work taking her highness down! Reekwater feels almost peaceful without her songs wafting around.

string.context: The quest isn't ready yet - come back later when it is
string.speaker: Nelda Horelica
string.name: NeldaHorelica

resources.string: You stopped her for now, but it's only a matter of time before the Siren Queen regains her strength and returns.
"What do you need?"

string.context: Responding to the player saying "What do you need?"
string.speaker: Lorenzo Blas
string.name: LorenzoBlas

resources.string: Aside from more time? More samples! I could use more Crystalized Azoth Blossoms from the caves. I have plenty of blight samples left over.

string.context: A reminder in case the player forgets
string.speaker: Lorenzo Blas
string.name: LorenzoBlas

resources.string: The Crystalized Azoth Blossoms found in the caves are of superior quality, perfect for my research.

string.context: The player has returned successful from the quest
string.speaker: Lorenzo Blas
string.name: LorenzoBlas

resources.string: Wonderful! You have the samples! Once these are analyzed, I'm certain we'll be close to a breakthrough!

string.speaker: Lorenzo Blas

resources.string: I need time to analyze the last batch of samples you brought me. Come back later. When this analysis is done, I’ll need more to test.
"From the Siren Queen's devices."

string.context: Responding to the player saying "From the Siren Queen's devices."
string.speaker: Hyloros
string.name: Hyloros

resources.string: We understand the resonance caused by such devices disrupts many things. We do not understand why so many insist on tinkering with the Ancient devices.

string.direction: Little inflection or changes, almost monotone.
string.context: Sending the player off on a quest
string.speaker: Hyloros
string.name: Hyloros

resources.string: No matter the origin, the rage that infects the Protector of the Source must be cleansed. We hope you will agree to help once more.

string.direction: Little inflection or changes, almost monotone.

string.speaker: Hyloros

string.speaker: Hyloros

resources.string: There is a calmness in the waters. The rage infecting the land has subsided, for now.

string.speaker: Hyloros
string.name: Hyloros

resources.string: The Protector of the Source is currently dormant. Soon enough they will bud forth, and you'll need to prune their expansion in Reekwater again.
"That sounds like a Heartgem."

string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: That’s exactly what I thought! So I said to myself, the only way we’re going to know if these Guardian Hearts are similar to Heartgems is by studying both.

string.context: Calls back to an earlier quest where the player helped recover a map.
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: But first, we’ll need to learn more about Ancient machinery. The map you recovered revealed several promising sites. I think we should start with those ruins.

string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: If only we had instructions for how to restart a Guardian Heartforge.
Complete the Quest

string.context: Disappointed there wasn't a working heartforge, but still happy with all the great schematics recovered
string.speaker: Jane Hargreve
string.name: JaneHargreve

resources.string: Too bad you didn't find a working Guardian Heartforge, but your efforts weren't in vain. You've recovered such valuable information!

string.context: The player has returned successfully from their quest! And Jane's already deciphering the tablets.
